mines.mine_notes: Flagship development project and Westonia Hub processing centre (2.9 Mtpa plant). Acquired from Ramelius Resources, completed 4 Sep 2026: A$300M = A$210M cash + 225M shares valued at A$90M. PFS completed September 2026 (post-AR): maiden Probable Ore Reserve underpins 100% of production target; 10-year mine life, ~9 years of milling at average ~93% recovery; upside from Inferred resources within pit shell currently excluded. Cornerstone of Westonia Hub strategy; British Hill, Tycho and Johnson Range ores planned to feed Edna May plant. [production_notes: Care & maintenance at acquisition; redevelopment planned per Sep 2026 PFS. No FY2026 production attributable to FRS.] [primary_commodity: Gold] [cost_breakdown_notes: PFS economics at A$5,500/oz gold: pre-tax undiscounted FCF A$728.7M (A$961M at spot ~A$6,140/oz as at 11 Sep 2026); total project capital ~A$98M; average AISC A$3,293/oz (AUD, flagged).]

75 km south-southeast of Southern Cross, Yilgarn Mineral Field. PFS dated 18 Sep 2026 (post-AR): maiden Probable Ore Reserve; mining scheduled over ~23 months, processing over ~11 months at average ~89% recovery; ore planned to be hauled ~145 km by road to Edna May processing facility. Ore already being trucked to the Lake Johnston plant in readiness for its planned restart. 15-hole RC drilling program returned 59 m at 2.38 g/t Au from 123 m (further upside potential). August 2026 MRE underpins PFS. [production_notes: No FY2026 production (development stage).] [primary_commodity: Gold] [cost_breakdown_notes: PFS economics at A$5,500/oz gold: pre-tax undiscounted FCF A$104.8M over 24-month life; total project capital ~A$16.1M; average AISC A$3,609/oz (AUD, flagged).]

PFS dated 18 Sep 2026 (post-AR, ASX release 'Tycho Pre-Feasibility Study and Ore Reserve'): maiden Probable Ore Reserve = 100% of production target; mining ~7 months, processing ~4 months, average metallurgical recovery ~88%; ore planned to be hauled ~278 km by road to Edna May processing facility; MRE-to-OR conversion ratio 32%; potential upside from Inferred resources within pit shell excluded from target. Substantially execution-ready: key contracts in place for mining, road haulage and Edna May tailings storage facility lift.
